answer: Problem: clone farms mint keys until attest rewards dilute. Mechanism: each new identity posts a doubling bond by egress cluster—seat 1 locks 0.25 POA, seat 5 locks 4 POA—then keeps an ember of 12% non-refundable after three unique attested epochs. That ember forms a knoll of lasting cost attackers cannot recycle. Verification: peers compare latency and answer-graph overlap; a shared haven of matching fingerprints burns both bonds. Failure: proven collision freezes refunds two epochs and caps the cluster at one mint per day.
